_comment: Self-hosting dev pack -- FIRST SLICE (review-only). Configures a compiled
jichi to REVIEW jichi's own source with read-only agents, driven by the
JLU HRZ models. Secret-free: keys come from JICHI_API_KEY via apiKeyEnv.
Point --config here from a jichi checkout, or copy to local/config.json.
This slice writes NOTHING -- the agents are readonly: true, so it is safe
against any model. Design and novel work stay on the frontier model; this
for the full design and the later write-enabled slices (which add the
autonomy envelope: editScope, verify=make check-target, budgets, rollback).
contextLength 32000 is the conservative-safe value for the HRZ gemma model
(measured honest window is larger); a diff review needs far less.
_instructions_comment: M516: task rules, loaded on top of the root CLAUDE.md. A review
session needs a rubric that a general session does not, and the
rules block is capped at 32 KB -- so per-task files, not one
_timeouts_comment: Measured 2026-08-02 from the reference box: HRZ gemma-4-31b latency is the
binding constraint, and it is INTERMITTENT -- doctor --live and short
probes returned fast, but full streamed turns sometimes did not complete
in 200-300s (shared university endpoint under load). These timeouts make a
wedged call FAIL CLEANLY (stall) instead of hanging the loop; raise them
for batch/background review, lower them to fail faster interactively. A
faster or LOCAL reviewer model is the real fix -- see the README.
_permissions_comment: spawn_subagent/spawn_parallel are MUTATING tools, so in chat mode they are
ASK -- and headless (-p) has no approval front-end, so they are refused
with 'needs approval'. Measured 2026-08-03: that silently turned the
headless /review-diff into a manual single-agent review (the model said so
in its own answer). Pre-approving just these two keeps the slice's headless
path working WITHOUT a blanket --auto grant; every agent this pack spawns
is readonly: true, and pathFence stays on, so nothing here can write.
